snippet.title: Making the most confusing metroidvania | Metro Gravity Devlog #0
snippet.description:
Wishlist Metro Gravity rn!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2986450/Metro_Gravity/ 

Join the discord!
https://discord.gg/RM5hktBqrv

Other socials: https://linktr.ee/mrkogamedev

I'm adding my piece of the pie to the ever growing list of solo indie games in this new devlog series! 
What you see is the result of about 1-2 months of what I would consider "real work" in my free time after school.

Like, share and subscribe regardless of whether or not you liked the video! :3
